-- Step 1: Create index (run once)
-- These indexes support the most selective filters and critical join conditions.
CREATE INDEX idx_keyword_keyword ON keyword(keyword);
CREATE INDEX idx_company_name_name ON company_name(name);
CREATE INDEX idx_title_production_year ON title(production_year);
CREATE INDEX idx_movie_keyword_keyword_id ON movie_keyword(keyword_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_movie_companies_company_id ON movie_companies(company_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_movie_companies_movie_id ON movie_companies(movie_id);


-- Step 2: Run the optimized query
-- This version uses modern, explicit JOINs for clarity and removes redundant join conditions.
SELECT MIN(cn.name) AS from_company,
       MIN(mc.note) AS production_note,
       MIN(t.title) AS movie_based_on_book
FROM keyword AS k
JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
JOIN title AS t ON t.id = mk.movie_id
JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON t.id = mc.movie_id
JOIN company_name AS cn ON mc.company_id = cn.id
JOIN company_type AS ct ON mc.company_type_id = ct.id
JOIN movie_link AS ml ON t.id = ml.movie_id
JOIN link_type AS lt ON ml.link_type_id = lt.id
WHERE k.keyword IN ('sequel',
                    'revenge',
                    'based-on-novel')
  AND t.production_year > 1950
  AND mc.note IS NOT NULL
  AND (cn.name LIKE '20th Century Fox%'
       OR cn.name LIKE 'Twentieth Century Fox%')
  AND cn.country_code != '[pl]'
  AND ct.kind != 'production companies'
  AND ct.kind IS NOT NULL;
